title: Native died of police beating, chief says
article: The RCMP have launched an internal probe into the death of \[Paul Alphonse\], a chronic alcoholic and street person.
An elderly native man who died after an alleged police beating had four broken ribs and a compressed vertebral fracture, his family and band chief say.
Paul Alphonse, 67, of Williams Lake, B.C., died in hospital Tuesday, a week after he was taken there from jail.
The RCMP have launched an internal probe into the death of Alphonse, a chronic alcoholic and street person.
